note: Set B captures the key structural facts correctly — shear webs of biaxial glass/foam sandwich, spar caps of pultruded carbon, trailing edge reinforcement of unidirectional glass, skin triaxial, the ~50% span aft shear web and the 6×6 stiffness/inertia matrices — while Set A misstates the trailing edge reinforcement as unidirectional carbon and invents several dimensional claims (blade length 135/120 m, max width 4 m, chord 5 m, Z range 0–100 m) that are not in the text and only loosely read off axes. Set A also has vague 'internal structural layout' claims and a duplicated uniaxial glass placement entry. Set B is not flawless: it repeats the shear-web material several times, binds the sandwich material to the whole blade, gives an unsupported quote for 'pultruded carbon', and likewise invents a 135 m blade length from axis readings, but its errors are fewer and its correct claims more substantive.
